(import scheme (chicken base) (chicken io))

(define (run-commands commands)
  (let loop ((commands commands) (balance 0) (raw-outputs '()))
    (if (null? commands)
        (reverse raw-outputs)
        (let* ((line (car commands))
               (words (string-split line #\space))
               (new-balance balance)
               (output '()))
          (cond
            ((and (= (length words) 2) (string=? (car words) "deposit"))
             (let ((amt (string->number (cadr words))))
               (if (and amt (>= amt 0))
                   (set! new-balance (+ balance amt)))))
            ((and (= (length words) 2) (string=? (car words) "withdraw"))
             (let ((amt (string->number (cadr words))))
               (if (and amt (>= amt 0))
                   (if (> amt new-balance)
                       (set! output '("error"))
                       (set! new-balance (- new-balance amt))))))
            ((= (length words) 1) (string=? (car words) "balance")))
          (loop (cdr commands) new-balance (cons (if (null? output) (number->string new-balance) (car output)) raw-outputs))))))

(define (main)
  (let* ((n (string->number (read-line)))
         (commands (build-list n read-line))
         (results (run-commands commands)))
    (for-each display results)
    (newline)))

(main)
